name: fibonacci_intraday_retracement
mechanism: On NIFTY, the 09:15-10:15 opening range crystallizes overnight positioning and early institutional order flow into a single high-low anchor. The 61.8% Fibonacci retracement of this range is pre-loaded into virtually every systematic algo and institutional desk as a standing limit-order cluster — making it a self-fulfilling magnet at the index level (more so than on individual stocks, because more strategies monitor NIFTY Fibonacci levels simultaneously). When NIFTY price wicks into this level mid-session and closes back through it within a 5-second bar, the dense resting order queue at the level provides the microstructure impulse: on the long side, VWAP-benchmarked funds accumulating below their benchmark price absorb the dip aggressively; on the short side, delta-hedging from option sellers adds directional supply at the resistance.
